newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells two Aug diesel cargoes, $20.30-$20.50.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells two Aug diesel cargoes, $20.30-$20.50.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) sold by tender two cargoes of 0.3-percent sulphur gas oil at around $20.30-$20.50 per barrel for liftings in August, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
Each cargo is between 225,000 and 250,000 barrels and will be for August 15-20 and August 25-29 liftings, on a free-on-board (fob) basis to Kaohsiung.
Traders said the cargoes were awarded to a Swiss oil trading firm and a US major oil company.
In its last tender, CPC sold one gas oil cargo for July 23-27 lifting at about 50 cents per barrel below Singapore spot quotes, fob Kaohsiung.
